annotations.title: Read a tournament or hidden-list game

description: Returns a tournament or hidden-list game as the signed-in player may see it: rules (format, size, points, what lists may break), dates, entrants with whether each sealed, your entry, Swiss rounds with your table and opponent, standings once lists are revealed, your battles in it, and todo: what you still need to do. Before the reveal nobody's list is shown but your own name for it. Requires mcp:read.

eventToken.description: eventToken from list_my_events; only an old link needs it.

token.description: The tournament or hidden-list game token, from list_my_events or its invite link.
